summary: Comprehensive testing of Scan Dish feature (AI-powered dish identification). All features working correctly - backend API accepts base64 images and returns matched menu items with nutrition data, frontend has floating camera button, scan modal with Take Photo/Upload Image options, and displays full nutrition card with Order for Pickup button.
critical_code_review_comments: Scan Dish API implementation is well-structured with proper error handling for missing image_base64
AI integration uses GPT-4.1 vision via Emergent LLM - working correctly with real image recognition
Frontend floating camera button has proper data-testid and tooltip on hover
Scan modal correctly shows Take Photo and Upload Image options with proper data-testid attributes
ScanResultPanel component displays all required fields: dish name, price, category, badges, nutrition panel, and action buttons
Nutrition panel in scan result shows calories, macros, health benefits, Ayurvedic wisdom, dietary tags, and allergens
Previously tested features (menu item nutrition modal, dietary badges) still work correctly
seed_data_creation: None - used PIL-generated food-like test images for API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scan Dish feature is fully functional. Backend uses GPT-4.1 vision via Emergent LLM integration. Frontend has floating camera button (data-testid='scan-dish-btn') in bottom-right corner. Scan modal shows Take Photo and Upload Image options. After scan, result shows matched dish with nutrition panel and Order for Pickup button.
